items.name: Donnie
items.text: Brian's seaplane pilot in the Keys. Drops the packages, skims a little, deals on the side.

items.name: Kenton Rees
items.text: Treasure hunter on Key Lento. Runs Island Dreams dive charters and buys what you pull up.

items.name: Mattia
items.text: Kat's boyfriend from Vice City. Yacht money, Italian charm, a boss he never names.

items.name: Tyrone
items.text: La Perle dealer. Buys what Jason flips and wants to know who cooks Kitty Litter.

items.name: Kordell Grant
items.text: KG. Bodybuilder, crew boss, ex-con. Runs his crew out of Ajax Gym and wants the whole city.
